subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: Summary The passage talks about the life and worker of John Milton. Born in 1608, he took his MA degree from Cambridge University. He had a great exposure to classical literature. This exposure helps him to write such a great piece like The Paradise Lost. It was published in 1664. This great man passed away in 1674.
